profile.name: OWIS PS10 电机定位控制器
profile.description: 这是一种用于驱动电动位移机构或步进电机轴的运动控制器，可对电机进行激活、参数配置、按位置计数移动，并读取运动状态与当前位置。它常用于实验室中的精密位移调节，如光学元件、样品台或旋转/线性平台的自动定位。
profile.description_en: This is a motion controller for driving motorized positioning devices or stepper-motor axes. It can activate motors, configure motion-related parameters, move to a target position in counts, and report motion status and current position. It is commonly used in laboratories for precise positioning of optical components, sample stages, and linear or rotary translation assemblies.
